title: Tailwise Autoship Allowance on a Tailwise Plus Premier Annual Upgrade
content:
**Pals Rewards and Tailwise Plus.** On a move up from Tailwise Plus Annual to Tailwise Plus Premier Annual, a Premier Autoship allowance — a flat dollar amount — is subtracted from the upgrade charge according to the charged shipments that the customer's Tailwise Autoship subscriptions carry dated in the last six months, all subscriptions counted together.

| Charged Tailwise Autoship shipments dated in the last six months | Premier Autoship allowance |
|---|---|
| 6 or more | $8.00 |
| 3 to 5 | $4.00 |
| fewer than 3 | none |

**Edges (hypothetical).** 2 shipments: none. 3: $4.00. 5: $4.00. 6: $8.00.
